works.title: Oracle
works.description: A personal AI reasoning system that accepts questions and problems, maps relevant information sources, produces actionable documentation (Ledgers), applies escalation logic and governance criteria, and maintains append-only audit trails. Designed as a living instrument for truth-seeking and decision support with persistent encrypted memory and conflict resolution via precedent documentation.
works.quote: I have spent the last ten or eleven months formulating and crystallizing an idea that has come together into a specific project: the Oracle. I now know exactly what I want to create, why I want to create it, and I have assembled all the tools necessary to complete the work.
